source_analysis.original_ui: Read-only direct navigation of My-items settings and code tree, voucher barcode, barcode verification, discount, BOM requirements, profit, amount-adjustment prerequisite and five plan-generation menu choices. No original record saved or generated.

implementation_boundaries: Purchase-plan generation, personal item groups, barcode helpers and held drafts operate on browser business records; they are not a new server synchronization engine.
My-items groups are personal browser/account settings; shared groups and cross-device synchronization are not implemented.
Voucher codes use explicit REAERP:1 format or our saved document number; original ECOUNT scanner encoding and physical scanner behavior are unverified.
Profit uses registered net purchasing price or configured standard costs; historical FIFO and monthly closing valuations are not implemented.
BOM includes local multi-level composition and loss factors; representative-item conversion and external production plans are not implemented.
Amount adjustments disclose actual rounding differences and require acceptance before application. Currency conversion is not implemented.

Plan grouping protects distinct warehouse, currency, tax and other header terms. Single-order mode requires an explicit recipient; incompatible same-item values require line mode. These policies do not claim original private-server equivalence.
Held drafts live in the current page session and are not business documents; refresh persistence and the original hold-save API are not implemented.
Hosted deployment and hosted app-account verification are recorded separately on the management Page.
